title: Training Elephants
question: At what point does the training of a captive wild elephant begin?

meanings.usage: 修饰动物或人，指失去自由、被关起来的状态
指被关押或圈养的对象
用于按顺序对应前面提到的两个或多个事物
用来描述人或动物因受不公对待而产生怨恨情绪的状态
常用结构assign sb. to sth./to do sth.，表示分派某人做某项工作或负责某个对象
特指以训练、看管大象为职业的人
不可数名词，指对人或事物的喜爱、眷恋之情，常与for/to搭配
常用搭配pine for sb./sth.表示思念，pine away表示日渐消瘦
固定搭配deprive sb. of sth.，表示夺去某人原本拥有的东西
引申义为突出某个事实或观点的重要性，相当于emphasize
常与to搭配，指愿意服从他人命令的状态
指动物或人突然用力地向前冲、扭动身体的动作
特指用绳索把动物拴在某个固定物体上
形容问题或任务需要小心处理，稍有不慎就会出问题
形容声音、动作等能让人或动物情绪平静下来
常用复数形式，指为了让对方听从自己而说的好听的话

phrases.usage: 介词短语，可表示“除了……之外（还）”或“除了……之外（都不）”，相当于besides或except for

examples.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training.
examples.zh: 且不说道德方面的考虑，这种训练方法本身就很愚蠢。

examples.en: Apart from English, he also learns French and Japanese.
examples.zh: 除了英语之外，他还学习法语和日语。

phrases.phrase: take sth. with a grain of salt
phrases.usage: 固定习语，表示对某事半信半疑，不完全相信

examples.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 这类极端案例可能不能完全当真。

examples.en: You should take what he says with a grain of salt, he often exaggerates.
examples.zh: 他说的话你得打个折扣听，他经常夸张。

phrases.usage: 习语，意为“挣钱维持生计；值得雇佣”，指通过劳动抵消自己的生活成本

examples.en: It is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
examples.zh: 这个年龄的大象差不多已经可以干重活，能立刻开始干活抵偿饲养成本了。

examples.en: Even as a teenager, he did part-time jobs to earn his keep instead of relying on his parents.
examples.zh: 甚至十几岁的时候，他就靠打零工养活自己，不依赖父母。

phrases.usage: 被动结构，表示“被剥夺……；失去……”，后接被夺走的事物

examples.en: They have been deprived of their own trainer.
examples.zh: 他们被夺走了自己的驯象师。

examples.en: Many children in remote areas are deprived of the right to receive education.
examples.zh: 很多偏远地区的孩子被剥夺了受教育的权利。

phrases.usage: 介词短语，表示“在……的伴奏下；伴随着……

examples.en: Others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
examples.zh: 其他人一边摸着它的皮肤，一边唱着单调的、让人安心的歌谣。

examples.en: The performance began to the accompaniment of warm applause.
examples.zh: 演出在热烈的掌声中拉开了序幕。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示“易受……影响的；对……敏感的”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments.
examples.zh: 大象并不会立刻就吃这套哄骗的把戏。

examples.en: Babies are susceptible to colds when the weather changes suddenly.
examples.zh: 天气骤变的时候，婴儿很容易感冒。

phrases.usage: 动词短语，意为“由……组成”，不用于被动语态，主语是整体，宾语是组成部分

examples.en: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
examples.zh: 前一种方法无非就是强迫大象干活，打它，直到它按要求做事为止。

examples.en: The research team consists of three professors and five graduate students.
examples.zh: 这个研究团队由三名教授和五名研究生组成。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示“有能力做……；能够做出……”，后接名词或动名词

examples.en: Elephants are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
examples.zh: 大象能产生相当深厚的个人感情。

examples.en: This new device is capable of detecting even tiny leaks in the pipe.
examples.zh: 这个新设备甚至能检测到管道里极其微小的泄漏。

sentences.en: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
sentences.zh: 训练大象主要有两种方法，我们可以分别称之为“严酷法”和“温和法”。

sentences.en: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
sentences.zh: 前一种方法就是让一头大象去干活，然后鞭打它，直到它按要求去做。

sentences.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training,
sentences.zh: 撇开所有道德因素不谈，这是一种愚蠢的训练方法，

sentences.en: for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer.
sentences.zh: 因为它会使动物心怀怨恨，而且在以后很可能会成为“杀人犯”。

sentences.en: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages,
sentences.zh: 温和法在早期阶段需要更多的耐心，

sentences.en: but produce a cheerful good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service.
sentences.zh: 但它会培养出性情愉快、脾气温顺的大象，这种大象会提供多年的忠诚服务。

sentences.en: The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job.
sentences.zh: 训练大象的首要任务是给它指派一位驯象师，由他全权负责这项工作。

sentences.en: Elephants like to have one master just as dogs do, and are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
sentences.zh: 大象像狗一样喜欢只有一个主人，并且能够产生相当程度的个人感情。

sentences.en: There are even stories of half-trained elephant calves who have refused to feed and pined to death
sentences.zh: 甚至有这样的故事：一些半驯化的小象，它们拒绝进食并悲伤而死，

sentences.en: when by some unavoidable circumstance they have been deprived of their own trainer.
sentences.zh: 当它们因某些不可避免的情况失去了自己的驯象师时。

sentences.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt,
sentences.zh: 这种极端的例子也许不能完全相信，

sentences.en: but they do underline the general principle that the relationship between elephant and mahout is the key to successful training.
sentences.zh: 但它们确实强调了一个普遍原则：驯象师与大象之间的关系是训练成功的关键。

sentences.en: The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between 15 and 20 years,
sentences.zh: 捕获大象进行训练最经济的年龄是15到20岁之间，

sentences.en: for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
sentences.zh: 因为这个年龄段的大象几乎已经准备好承担重活，可以立即开始赚钱养活自己。

sentences.en: But animals of this age do not easily become subservient to man, and a very firm hand must be employed in the early stages.
sentences.zh: 但这个年龄的动物不容易顺从人类，所以在早期阶段必须采用非常强硬的手段。

sentences.en: The captive elephant, still roped to a tree,
sentences.zh: 被俘获的大象，仍然被绳子系在一棵树上，

sentences.en: plunges and screams every time a man approaches, and for several days will probably refuse all food through anger and fear.
sentences.zh: 每当有人靠近，它就会猛冲并尖叫，而且好几天可能会因愤怒和恐惧而拒绝所有食物。

sentences.en: Sometimes a tame elephant is tethered nearby to give the wild one confidence,
sentences.zh: 有时，一头驯服的大象会被拴在附近，以给野象信心，

sentences.en: and in most cases the captive gradually quietens down and begins to accept its food.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，被俘获的大象会逐渐平静下来，并开始接受食物。

sentences.en: The next stage is to get the elephant to the training establishment,
sentences.zh: 下一个阶段是将大象带到训练机构，

sentences.en: a ticklish business which is achieved with the aid of two tame elephants roped to the captive on either side.
sentences.zh: 这是一项棘手的工作，需要两头驯服的大象分别系在被俘获的大象两侧来完成。

sentences.en: When several elephants are being trained at one time,
sentences.zh: 当几头大象同时被训练时，

sentences.en: it is customary for the new arrival to be placed between the stalls of two captives whose training is already well advanced.
sentences.zh: 习惯上会将新来的大象放置在两头已经训练有素的被俘大象的兽栏之间。

sentences.en: It is then left completely undisturbed with plenty of food and water
sentences.zh: 然后它被完全地置于安静的环境中，提供充足的食物和水，

sentences.en: so that it can absorb the atmosphere of its new home and see that nothing particularly alarming is happening to its companions.
sentences.zh: 这样它就能适应新家的环境，并看到它的同伴们没有发生什么特别令人担忧的事情。

sentences.en: When it is eating normally, its own training begins.
sentences.zh: 当它正常进食时，它自己的训练就开始了。

sentences.en: The trainer stands in front of the elephant holding a long stick with a sharp metal point.
sentences.zh: 驯象师站在大象前面，手持一根带有锋利金属尖头的长棍。

sentences.en: Two assistants, mounted on tame elephants, control the captive from either side,
sentences.zh: 两名助手骑在驯服的大象上，从两侧控制被俘获的大象，

sentences.en: while others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
sentences.zh: 同时其他人则在大象的皮肤上摩擦双手，并伴随着单调而舒缓的歌谣。

sentences.en: This is supposed to induce pleasurable sensations in the elephant,
sentences.zh: 这应该在大象身上引起愉悦的感觉，

sentences.en: and its effects are reinforced by the use of endearing epithets,
sentences.zh: 它的效果通过使用亲切的称呼得到加强，

sentences.en: such as 'ho! my son', or 'ho! my father', or 'my mother', according to the age and sex of the captive.
sentences.zh: 比如“嘿！我的孩子”，“嘿！我的父亲”，或者“我的母亲”，这取决于被俘大象的年龄和性别。

sentences.en: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments, however, and usually lashes fiercely with its trunk in all directions.
sentences.zh: 然而，大象不会立即屈服于这种哄骗，通常会用象鼻猛烈地向四面八方挥舞。

sentences.en: These movements are controlled by the trainer with the metal-pointed stick,
sentences.zh: 这些动作由驯象师用金属尖头棍控制，

sentences.en: and the trunk eventually becomes so sore that the elephant curls it up and seldom afterwards uses it for offensive purposes.
sentences.zh: 象鼻最终会变得非常疼痛，以至于大象会把它卷起来，并且之后很少用于攻击目的。

options: 虚拟语气（与现在事实相反的情况）

这些人的史诗记载，他们中的一部分人大约在2000年前从印度尼西亚迁徙而来。
exercises.explain: but produce a cheerful good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service. — 但它会培养出性情愉快、脾气温顺的大象，这种大象会提供多年的忠诚服务。

source.en: but produce a cheerful good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service.

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.definition: 对主句中的某个名词或整个主句内容进行补充说明，去掉之后不影响主句的完整意思，通常和主句之间用逗号隔开
grammar.usage: 用来补充额外信息，which可指代前面的整个句子或句子中的某个名词，who指代人

examples.en: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
examples.zh: 训练大象主要有两种方法，我们可以分别称之为强硬法和温柔法。

examples.en: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages, which produces a cheerful good-tempered elephant.
examples.zh: 温柔法在初期需要更多耐心，这种方法能训练出性格开朗温顺、能多年忠诚服役的大象。

grammar.title: 原因状语从句
grammar.definition: 用来解释主句动作或情况发生的原因，常用引导词有for, because, since, as等
grammar.usage: for引导的原因状语从句通常不放在句首，是对前面内容的补充说明，语气比because弱

examples.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training, for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer.
examples.zh: 且不说道德方面的考虑，这种训练方法本身就很愚蠢，因为它会让动物产生怨恨，之后很可能会变成伤人的野兽。

examples.en: The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between 15 and 20 years, for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work.
examples.zh: 捕捉大象进行训练最划算的年龄是15到20岁之间，因为这个年龄的大象差不多已经可以干重活了。

patterns.pattern: Two main ... have been used for ..., which we may call respectively A and B.

original.en: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
original.zh: 训练大象主要有两种方法，我们可以分别称之为强硬法和温柔法。

examples.en: Two main methods have been used for learning foreign languages, which we may call respectively the rote-learning method and the immersion method.
examples.zh: 学习外语主要有两种方法，我们可以分别称之为死记硬背法和沉浸法。

examples.en: Two main solutions have been proposed for this environmental problem, which we may call respectively the technological approach and the policy approach.
examples.zh: 针对这个环境问题，人们提出了两种主要解决方案，我们可以分别称之为技术方案和政策方案。

patterns.pattern: The first essential in ... is to ... who will be responsible for ...

original.en: The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job.
original.zh: 训练大象的第一要务是给大象指派一名专门的驯象师，由他全权负责这项工作。

examples.en: The first essential in project management is to appoint a project manager who will be entirely responsible for the whole process.
examples.zh: 项目管理的第一要务是任命一名项目经理，由他全权负责整个流程。

examples.en: The first essential in dog training is to let the dog recognize a sole owner who will be responsible for its daily care and instruction.
examples.zh: 训练狗狗的第一要务是让狗狗认可唯一的主人，由主人负责它的日常照顾和指令训练。

patterns.pattern: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that ...

original.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that the relationship between elephant and mahout is the key to successful training.
original.zh: 这类极端案例可能不能完全当真，但它们确实突出了一个普遍原则：大象和驯象师之间的关系是训练成功的关键。

examples.en: Such unbelievable success stories must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that persistent effort is the foundation of achievement.
examples.zh: 这类令人难以置信的成功故事可能不能完全当真，但它们确实突出了一个普遍原则：持续的努力是成就的基础。

examples.en: Such rare medical cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that early detection of disease greatly improves treatment effects.
examples.zh: 这类罕见的医疗案例可能不能完全当真，但它们确实突出了一个普遍原则：疾病的早期发现能极大提升治疗效果。
